meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据简报灵活创作多场景视频作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作多场景视频或品牌短片
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit multi-scene video compositions from a brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to produce multi-scene videos or brand reels

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 将按通用视频流程创建或编辑自定义 HyperFrames 合成，包括更新技能、读取项目状态、制定计划、构建场景、处理媒体与动效，并产出分镜文档。适用于较长或多场景作品、品牌片、蒙太奇等。
howto.when: 当没有专门视频工作流适用，或 BRIEF.md 中 flow 为 companion 时触发。多用于长/多场景作品、品牌片、蒙太奇等。

say.text: 按 BRIEF.md 开始制作这个多场景视频项目。
say.note: Claude 会读取项目状态并创建计划与场景。

say.text: 把这几段素材混剪成一段 30 秒的品牌宣传片。
say.note: 会更新技能并应用媒体适配器。

say.text: 为我的产品制作一个静态标题卡。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应合成，并处理媒体与动效。

howto.what_en: Claude creates/edits custom HyperFrames compositions: updates skill, reads project state, plans, builds scenes, handles media & motion, outputs storyboards. For longer/multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized video workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Typically used for longer/multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, etc.

say_en.text: Start producing this multi-scene video project per BRIEF.md.
say_en.note: Claude reads project state, then creates plan & scenes.

say_en.text: Cut these clips into a 30-second brand spot.
say_en.note: Skill updates and applies media adapters.

say_en.text: Make a static title card for my product.
say_en.note: Claude builds the composition and handles media & motion.
